svg.text: Citywide exterior rail loop + adjacent promenade · source-bound concept
cyan: two-direction rail loop candidate · green dashed: segregated promenade candidate · no construction alignment or opening authority
Existing inventory: gold = current-source MP06 207-station road trace; orange = accepted 534-station MP07 bounded walk trace.
Purple boxes are protected catalog interfaces. Gates terminate on the exterior loop; they do not enter any town, road, station, C1, portal, or underground system.
Before any finite build: fresh exact terrain/fluid/ownership survey, a vertical/receiver design, an inverse, protected-core/entity clearance, and route QA.
